title: Austin Leaders Head to Private Talks
summary:
*   Austin city leaders held a special, brief public meeting.
*   The sole agenda item was to announce the immediate transition to a closed-door executive session.
*   This private meeting was authorized by state law to discuss confidential matters.
*   Any final decisions resulting from the executive session would be announced publicly during an open meeting.

MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
October 11, 1978
4:00
P.M.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call:
Present:
Mayor McClellan, Mayor Pro Tern Cooke, Councilmembers Mullen, Himmelblau, Snell, Trevino,
Goodman
Absent:
None
Mayor McClellan opened the meeting, stating that this was a Special Called Meeting of the
City Council for the purpose of publicly announcing that it will convene in a closed or
executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article 6252-17,
Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or executive session any
final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered in the closed or
executive session would be made in open session, should such action, decision or vote be
necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated.
APPROVED . ,„ .„
